name: hardcoded-spacing
description: Tailwind utilities that use arbitrary values for spacing — m-[3px], p-[7px], gap-[5px], etc. These bypass the design-token system; the agent should map each to the nearest spacing token or surface a system gap.

anyOf.reason: Arbitrary margin value — map to a spacing token or surface a system gap.
Arbitrary padding value — map to a spacing token.
Arbitrary gap value — map to a spacing token.
Arbitrary space-x/y value — map to a spacing token.
Arbitrary position offset — map to a token or surface a system gap.
